name: runner
description: Runs a space's AI sessions on this computer: sandboxed, in an encrypted workspace opened by a leased key, with credentials fetched at the moment of use and a checkpoint at every turn.

tools.name: runner.status
tools.summary: whether this computer can run a space's sessions, and what is running

tools.name: runner.place
tools.summary: where a session would run: here, the server, or waiting, with the reason

tools.name: runner.start
tools.summary: start a session here: the kernel supplies its program, routes and credentials (both grants needed)

tools.name: runner.recover
tools.summary: put an own-server session back to its last sealed turn before it is resumed

tools.name: runner.lock
tools.summary: close the workspace on this computer; the data stays encrypted

tools.name: runner.move
tools.summary: move a chat's session to the server, or bring it back to a computer; answers where it runs now

tools.name: runner.revoke
tools.summary: the home says the grant ended: stop the sessions and delete the local work

tools.name: runner.places
tools.summary: where each of your chats runs: on the server or on a computer, and whether it is connected

tools.name: runner.placement
tools.summary: where a chat's session runs now, its state, why it moved, its epoch and whether it may come back

tools.name: runner.why-not
tools.summary: why a chat's session is not running on a computer: one reason code

tools.name: runner.settings
tools.summary: this computer's limits for running sessions

tools.name: runner.settings.set
tools.summary: change this computer's limits for running sessions

tools.name: runner.here
tools.summary: the sessions running on this computer now, with what each uses

tools.name: runner.pause-all
tools.summary: freeze every session on this computer until resumed

tools.name: runner.resume-all
tools.summary: let the frozen sessions on this computer carry on

list.empty: Nothing is running on this computer.

settings.label: Let sessions run on this computer
settings.help: Off: a space's sessions run on its server. On: they may run here too, within the limits below, and move to the server when a limit is passed.

settings.label: Only while plugged in
settings.help: On battery, a session moves to the server.

settings.label: Processor limit (percent)
settings.help: The most of one processor core the sessions here may use together. Past it, a session moves to the server.

settings.label: Memory limit (megabytes)
settings.help: The most memory the sessions here may use together. Past it, a session moves to the server.
